deadline.value: Complete PhD applications are due December 1, 2026 for fall 2027.
deadline.quote: The deadline for completed PhD applications is December 1, 2026 for fall 2027 admission.

fee_waiver.value: Hardship waiver by online form only (not by email); reviewed individually and may be partial or full.
fee_waiver.quote: If the application fee would cause financial hardship, please complete this form to request a fee waiver for the Department of Biology Graduate Application. | Waivers may be granted partially or entirely based on the committee's evaluation.

gre_general.value: The GRE General test is optional, with no minimum score.
gre_general.quote: As noted above, the GRE general test is optional. Our department does not require a minimum score for the GRE general exam.

gre_subject.value: The Biology GRE Subject test is optional.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE subject test in biology is also optional.

supervisor.value: Students rotate through three labs in year one and then choose an advisor by mutual agreement.
supervisor.quote: Each student rotates in three laboratories in the first year, at the end of which he/she chooses a faculty advisor by mutual agreement.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students get a stipend, health insurance and full tuition, guaranteed for five years subject to progress; internationals are eligible for the same internal funding.
funding.quote: All PhD students admitted to the program are offered a competitive annual stipend (research or teaching assistantship), Aetna health insurance, and a full tuition scholarship. | Support is guaranteed for five years subject to satisfactory progress toward the degree.

also.quote: International applicants will be reviewed without prejudice and are eligible for the same internal funding opportunities as US citizens.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in biology or a related field is required; a master's is not.
entry_route.quote: Students applying to the PhD program are required to have a bachelor's degree in biology or a related field. A master's degree is not required.

notes: Selected PhD candidates are interviewed by Zoom, typically late January or early February.
